desc: Take full control of your custom build with the Wheeler Gas Block Taper Pin Removal Tool. Whether you have a vise or a ball pin hammer, the Support Block, paired with the starter and finishing punches makes removing A2 style gas blocks quick and easy. Built with durable tool steel. Works on A2 front sights, S&W single-taper pin gas blocks and dual taper pins. Includes a finishing punch and a starter punch.
